file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email uses `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` defaulting to `http://localhost:3000` (`src/notifications/templates.ts`), which causes links in production emails to point to localhost instead of the configured application domain.

input.title: Use configuration domain for email notification links
input.body: Proposed change in src/notifications/templates.ts: update BASE_URL to use the application configuration instead of process.env.PUBLIC_URL so that password reset and other email links correctly reflect the production domain rather than defaulting to localhost.
